colour_accents: Sodium heads (4): street lights 1 and 2 on the near kerb, yard posts A and B - warm orange pools, the night's main colour.
Cold LED heads (2) outside the windows and the warm LED at the door - blue-white on the floor through the glass, warm on the stoop.
The two floodlights (facade over the bay, wing eave) - cold white rakes down the reversing bay and across the containers.
The lit working bay, the four office windows and the UNIT 7 sign - warm rectangles at the top right after dusk.
The amber beacon over the drain pit, blinking - the one moving colour in the band above the back wall.
The two spray tags: HELLO FRIEND (magenta) on the wing, 404 (cyan) on the facade - the only saturated paint.
Four cones (orange): two at the drain pit, one seen through the door, one over the broken gutter grate on the footpath.
Everything else - road, kerbs, truck, billboard face (blank, peeling), containers, poles, weeds, the neighbours' units - goes through the grey wash by day and is dark at night.
sightlines: Camera frame (yaw 45, tilt 35.5, 90 m lens): u = 0.707(x - z), v = 0.814y - 0.411(x + z); zoom 1 shows v +-10 and about u +-16; the ray descends 1 m per 0.99 m in both -x and -z. The horizon is 35 deg above the frame at every zoom (min 0.8) and orbit (+-31.5 deg): no sky and nothing 'distant' is ever in frame; the top edge is ground 25-31 m out, covered by the facade, its roof slab and the wing's roof.

notes:
Unit 7 is a warehouse on a back street in an industrial suburb; the den is its old brick gatehouse at the street corner of the lot, standing on its own plinth with its blank side to the footpath and its door opening into the yard.
The street runs along the +x side (a 6 m carriageway between kerbs at x 15 and 21, a wide footpath 10.5-15 on the lot side, poles on the far side with one crossing to the lot); the compound's 6 m gate opens off it at z -8..-14, one leaf standing open at 90 degrees along z -8, one folded back flat inside the fence; fence entries are panel centres, yaw 0 = panel runs along x, 90 = along z.
The compound is bounded by the warehouse front (z -17, trimmed to end at the property line x 10.5 with a new gable wall), the wing (x -17, one tile longer), chain-link along the street with a short return to the den's corner, and chain-link along z 9.5 from the den's other corner to the wing; inside are the reversing bay with its beacon and cones, the containers, skip and drums behind the windows, and the den's bin by its door.
The +z side is a vacant lot - dirt, four grass patches, weeds, dumped tyres and a pallet - behind the old brick-and-bar fence on the street (a jersey barrier across its collapsed crossover), with a blank billboard on its far line and temporary chain-link beyond; nothing taller than 1 m within 10 m of the plinth on either open side, nothing at all within 2 m.
Across the street a low unit opposite the gate, an open hardstand, a second unit further south - all beyond 26 m, only their tops at zoom 0.8; the three distant silhouettes are kept for a future zoom-out and are invisible today.
Dropped: the internal fences at x -12.5 and z -13, the yard truck at the closed bay (the street truck replaces it), the apron barriers, the drums/bags/cone in front of the open sides, the facade tiles at x 12 and 15. To convert: road-asphalt-pavement, road-asphalt-side, road-asphalt-center, grass, tree-shrub (weeds) from retro-urban at scale 3; sign-highway (billboard) at 6 and road-sign-warning (sign_warning) at 8 from roads; building-e (unit_e) and building-k (unit_k) from commercial at 10. No hydrant or bus stop exists in any kit, so neither is placed; the drains are primitives.
